clues.it: Tea era nella 5ª colonna e accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Tea was in the 5th column and beside a net.

clues.it: Marta era nella 13ª colonna e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Marta was in the 13th column and north of Anna.

clues.it: Elena era nella 3ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Elena was in the 3rd row and in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 11ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 11th column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Nino era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a un timone e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Nino was in the 3rd column, beside a helm and west of Dario.

clues.it: Vito era nella 6ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Fabio e da solo nel Faro.
clues.en: Vito was in the 6th row, in a different room from Fabio and alone in the Lighthouse.

clues.it: Anna era nella 12ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e da sola in Cabina, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Anna was in the 12th column, in the 7th row and alone in the Cabin, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 1ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 1st column, in the 8th row and north of Dario.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a un salvagente e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 8th column, beside a life ring and north of Ugo.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª colonna, nella 10ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th column, in the 10th row and in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Irene era esattamente una riga a nord di Sergio e sul Ponte, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Irene was exactly one row north of Sergio and on the Deck, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a un barile e in una stanza diversa da Bruno.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a barrel and in a different room from Bruno.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Luca era nella 14ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Anna, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Luca was in the 14th row and in a different room from Anna, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Ugo non era accanto a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Ugo was not beside a bunk.

general_clues.en: 7 in the west half of the grid.
7 in the north half of the grid.
